run-paths.interface: RunPaths owns validated run-id/path construction; no launch, lock or checkpoint implementation.

run-labels.interface: Label persistence only; no scheduler, publication or full launch metadata.

append-stamp.interface: Append invalidation stamps only; retain reader invalidation semantics.

public-identity.interface: Public run identifiers only; retain exact serialization and validation.

run-report.interface: Final report document and disk IO; facade preserves report API.

run-record.interface: LaunchRecord and its strict historical decoder remain together; engine configuration accessors are data, not engine implementation.

run-files.interface: Generic atomic JSON and append IO. Its durability implementation owns a narrow DiskOps port; real OS implementation is linked here, with process/clock facts passed in rather than importing process presentation.

run-locks.interface: OwnershipLock/Handover and process identity checks own liveness port. Used only by mutating commands, never launch metadata readers.

journal-reader.interface: Reading/loss accounting and stream merge_order are separate from Journal writer and summary maintenance. Full envelope/version validation remains real; registry is injected as immutable reader-owned input.

journal.interface: Journal open/append retains the real summary Maintainer and its synchronous cache updates. Separating journal-reader breaks the old cycle: journal depends on run-summary, which depends on checkpoint and journal-reader, never on the writer. Sequence allocation, tail healing and summary update ordering remain unchanged.

run-projection.interface: Pure deterministic event fold. Own a FoldOperations interface for validated edit operations; move the pure operation fold here, never link the edit transaction runner.

checkpoint.interface: Coverage seal, resume point, bounded streaming rebuild and derived checkpoint publication stay together. No scheduler or mutation transaction dependency; read paths still write this exact derived cache.

run-summary.interface: Summary DTO/cache/listing and the real append-driven Maintainer stay here. Journal imports Maintainer directly; queries use checkpoint and journal-reader, not the journal writer. No no-op callback replaces summary maintenance.

cross-run-query.interface: Reference parse and read-only upstream status resolution. Query owns UpstreamSnapshot source; release watcher uses it, but views do not import release polling or plan edits.

release-watch.interface: Release polling and adoption effects, separate from cross-run status reads. Query functions moved out; loop wiring owns polling callbacks.

planner-channel.interface: Channel transport, envelope validation, deliveries and schema/layout. ChannelState receives a channel-owned immutable queue/context DTO; no RunState or scheduler concrete dependency. Keep allowlists and unknown-field rejection. Command::Add and replacement operations retain the canonical plan::Node wire type, so plan-model remains a genuine dependency; no private replacement type hides it.

publication-boundary.interface: Pure envelope/boundary validation owns BoundaryContext DTO containing required plan facts; caller supplies it. It never imports plan loader, scheduler, or full run projection.

plan-validation.interface: Graph/criterion/destination validation owns DestinationFacts input. OS identity and dispatch policy are inputs, not dependencies on runtime control implementation.

plan-edits.interface: Pure staged edit validation and edit transaction logic own EditStore and CommitReceipt ports. Task-store implements persistence; scheduler supplies current state. Pure replay of committed operations lives in run-projection.

task-store.interface: Taskgraph store transactions implement plan-edits EditStore; no publication runner, release poller or complete runtime state. Own StoreEvents/ReleaseFacts inputs for the facts these operations consume.

publication-query.interface: On-disk landing reconciliation and publication status lookup own LandingReader. Retain every landing reread and evidence check used by RunView; no publishing, agent launch or repo mutation.

publication.interface: Publication effects: vcs, lifecycle, stack, closures and withdrawal. Own PublicationHost and PublicationEvents ports; real onevcs/GitHub implementation and refusal paths remain in this crate. Scheduler calls it; query consumers do not. Move publication/rework decision types from engine.rs into publication, using publication-owned snapshots rather than borrowing scheduler internals.

agent-session.interface: Graph session discovery/start and process identity. Extract graph transport/session primitives out of agent executor scheduling; command ask and stop-guard use only this capability.

agent-execution.interface: Dispatch/executor/pool implementation owns DispatchPublication callback for settled dispatch evidence. Scheduler wires real publication implementation; executor does not import the whole publication manager or task-store.

pool-maintenance.interface: Pool reclamation owns MaintenanceFacts + maintenance event sink; scheduler supplies full state, host scans use query facts. No agent executor or publication runner is imported just to inspect pool occupancy.

member-liveness.interface: Heartbeat records and applying liveness facts; consumer-owned LivenessTarget receives facts, so heartbeat never imports whole RunState.

run-views.interface: Read/render RunView and all view facets. RunView::open/refresh still perform derived checkpoint writes, heartbeat application, landing rereads and upstream refresh. Views own query DTOs for pool/dispatch/edits; the write-capable managers are not concrete dependencies.

loop-statistics.interface: Loop counters and telemetry records; paths and atomic store only, not launch/config/checkpoint aggregation.

run-metrics.interface: Metrics fold and DTOs consume event records, not scheduler, channel writer or publication transactions.

event-filter.interface: Pure event selectors; filter arguments are defined by commands and converted to selector DTOs, removing clap dependency.

diagnostics.interface: Error/refusal values and formatting only. Process details are captured at error construction, avoiding sys/render-cost import for every domain.

plan-model.interface: Strict plan wire model and branch template values. Host/process validation is delegated to explicit plan-validation context.

flow-session.interface: Flow registration/landing records and queue transport; lifecycle observes event snapshots through flow-owned input, not full run views.

watch-lease.interface: Watcher registration, cursors, leases and typed frames use immutable read facts, not command flag or view presentation types.

publication-debt.interface: Publication debt classifiers consume publication query and launch facts; never dispatch/agent executor implementation.

observation-debt.interface: Observation debt classifiers consume read-only watcher and run facts; no scheduler or publication.

branch-publication.interface: Branch publication operation remains real host/vcs integration. No driver loop or all views merely for rendering the receipt. The PR-author graph uses the real LocalExecutor; agent-session and agent-execution remain in every invoking runner.

channel-submission.interface: Submission/receipts preserve both driven queue/ack and undriven inline apply. Calls actual edit-reconciler after ownership admission; orphan queues are recovered and drained when the driver dies. No assumption that a scheduler is already running.

run-control.interface: Driver lifecycle, stop/shutdown and continuation. Own Drive entrypoint callback; start/adopt/drive composition wires scheduler and real executor. Stop and shutdown send protocol/cancel requests, without statically owning scheduler code.

scheduler.interface: Scheduling loop and convergence policies compose real subsystem effects; own ports for execution, publication, edits, release and journal events, wired by start/adopt/drive command composition. No command implementation dependency.

readjust-state.interface: Readjuster, detection evidence and retarget plan DTOs; absorb only merges observed facts. Effectful detection and execution remain readjustment; scheduler owns undriven execution continuation.

readjustment.interface: Real detect/refresh/readjust effects, including retarget and restack. Continuation into execution is finish_undriven in scheduler. Engine emission helpers are shared event-emission, not reverse scheduler calls.

review-discovery.interface: Real review discovery/pass and host integration. Review idempotence key belongs to review-replies; no dependency on a command implementation.

review-replies.interface: Review comment drafting/posting, not CLI reply. Own DeclineValidation enum with Compiled operations or ValidatedDecline; editor wraps that result into its private Staged. Preserve host posting, provenance and refusal assertions; key is shared here with discovery. Drafting retains the real Executor and cancellation implementation through agent-execution, not a fake callback.

event-emission.interface: Bounded event formatting, payload construction and delivery labels; no scheduling or command implementation. Every caller retains real journal/channel effects.

channel-admission.interface: Actual ownership-lock handover, queue claim/admission and reply wait policy. No edit application; admitted envelopes pass to edit-reconciler when the submitting process owns the undriven run.
